3) Invoice format: Do you need a specific invoice PDF layout or purchase order line items? We can provide a sample invoice and the contract/SOW in your preferred format (PDF/Docx).

4) Marketplace & procurement systems: you mentioned evaluating via your cloud marketplace procurement team — any marketplace SKU or procurement portal we should register with? If so, can procurement@brightleafhealth.com loop us in?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that’s easier to coordinate with procurement.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the SOW. Quick answers below from procurement side: 

- PO vs card: For pilots > $5k we generally require a PO. The initial pilot estimate you shared (~$8k) will need a PO.
- PO process: Procurement will need the SOW, a final contract, and an invoice after delivery. I’ve looped procurement@brightleafhealth.com — their intake form is short but they usually need a vendor W-9 and the vendor address for tax purposes.
- Net terms: Brightleaf standard is Net 30. We can accept Net 30 for this engagement.
- Invoice format & tax: Please include line items that map to the SOW milestones and total. We prefer PDF invoices with a separate line for tax/VAT where applicable. For US entities there’s no VAT; we will need your W-9 and the legal billing address for tax reporting.
- Billing address: Brightleaf will provide a PO number once procurement completes review. Our billing address for remit will be provided by procurement@brightleafhealth.com in their intake reply.
- Marketplace: We are evaluating purchases through our internal marketplace but for this pilot we will route via PO (marketplace evaluation can follow).

Can you share: 1) sample invoice PDF, 2) vendor W-9, 3) final SOW with legal entity name and billing address to put on the PO? Procurement will then kick off the PO creation.

Appreciate it — happy to review the SOW and get it to procurement early today.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Product Lead, Data & ML | Brightleaf Health
elena.martinez@brightleafhealth.com
